notes.title: Countdown to Release Day!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! We've managed to crawl our way to an eventual release date! Hurray! 🥳

[b]"Is It Wrong To Try To Rescue Monster Girls From The Inquisition?"[/b] releases on the [b]21st of April, 9:00 AM EST[/b].

We're also boasting a new gameplay trailer and new screenshots, showcasing exactly what's happening in the game and what isn't[b]*[/b]! 

[b]*[/b]Overly explicit stuff, that's what isn't happening. Sorry about that! We are keeping an open mind, however, although we won't be publishing any [i]roadmaps[/i] for the game anytime soon.

Many thanks to all of our lovely community members for their patience and support! ⭐
Since we've gotten this far, make sure you reach out if any problems pop up or if you just want to chat and share your thoughts and feedback.

Nothing more to add right now other than...[b] Enjoy the game![/b]
...and maybe "please don't be too harsh on the monster girls". They're just making their debut and learning along the way. 😋

notes.title: Tough Times Make Tougher Monster Girls
notes.content:
Hey, monster girl lovers!

I've got some unfortunate news today regarding the release of 'Is It Wrong To Try To Rescue Monster Girls From The Inquisition?'.

The game should have been released by now, but, as many of you know, I have been using AI assets in order to bring the monster girls and world to life.
That being the case, I recently received word from Steam that, due to potential copyright concerns, the game cannot be released on the platform in its current state.

This is a huge setback, but I am still committed to delivering this game to you folks, rest assured.

While the game has currently been released on platforms that allow AI-generated content, all AI-generated assets will be removed from the game and a brand-new version of it will be created to specifically comply with Steam's policies.

Yup, that means that pretty much all of the art assets will have to be redone from the ground up, so expect the game looking completely different when this is over with.

This will heavily delay our eventual Steam release, of course, and I am disappointed that we must jump through some extra hoops, but I completely understand Steam's position - this is all still uncharted territory.

My goal remains to create a fun and memorable game for you all to enjoy, no matter what roadblocks pop up along the way, so I'll keep at it!

You all have been so amazing and patient with your support! I cannot express my appreciation enough!
I'll keep you posted on all future news regarding the game, but feel free to hit me up for any questions or concerns.

notes.title: Update on game release date!
notes.content:
[b]Hello again, fellow monster girl rescuers![/b]

First of all, I want to give you all a big shoutout for supporting 'Is It Wrong To Try To Rescue Monster Girls From The Inquisition?'! [b]You guys are absolute legends![/b]

Now, here's the scoop:

I couldn't resist the temptation to double the in-game fun and add in some extra story chapters (maybe even a few secret ones, who knows?).
But with great chapters come great development times, so this also means we'll need just a bit more time before this experience is in mint condition and ready to be released. So, let's push the release date back by around a month, okay?

I know, I know, the anticipation is killing us all... But while I was initially aiming for a very brief experience (maybe under an hour), with the exciting new additions in the story and the puzzle levels you can expect about [b]3 hours of short and sweet playtime[/b]. And it's going to be well polished on top of that.  

Don't worry, it's going to be worth it!

So while we patiently count down the days, let's rally the troops! Spread the word to your friends with an impeccable taste for top-notch entertainment. Let them know that this fun little yarn is on the horizon, waiting to be explored!

Thanks again for sticking with the game as it gets its final touches and dresses up for the big day!

If you have any burning questions or suggestions, hit up the discussions forum. I'm all ears and eager to chat with you!

notes.title: A Heartfelt Thanks to our Monster Girl Rescuers!
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow heroes of the monster girl world!

I just wanted to pop in and say a big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who has wishlisted [i]'Is It Wrong To Try To Rescue Monster Girls From The Inquisition?'[/i] in the last week or so. 
[b]You all are amazing and your support has put a huge smile on both the monster girls' faces and mine![/b]

As you may already know, this is a solo developed project, and I'm doing my best to make the game stand out in all areas - from graphics to music, to puzzle gameplay bits and, last but not least, the [strike]silly[/strike] [b]ultra epic[/b] fantasy story.

I've been scouring the internet lately trying to get some more eyeballs to join our ranks, but it turns out getting your game out there when no one knows who you are isn't an easy task, [i]who could've guessed[/i]. So if you have any friends with similar exquisite tastes when it comes to quality entertainment please make sure they are properly informed about this upcoming hidden gem.

I promise to make the game as fun and engaging as it can be, cranking up the content and polish until the very last moment before release, so you can enjoy spending as much time as possible with your favorite monster girls. 

If you have any questions about the upcoming game, don't hesitate to drop a comment or a topic on the discussions forum. I'd be more than happy to talk to you! 

Once again, thank you so much for your unwavering support! Can't wait to share this adventure with you all.
